title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:
**Company Description**
CARLO IT SOLUTIONS LLP is an IT services and digital solutions provider focused on helping businesses strengthen their online presence and performance. The company works with clients across diverse industries, delivering technology-driven marketing and optimization strategies. Team members collaborate in a professional environment that values problem-solving, data-driven decisions, and continuous improvement. Joining CARLO IT SOLUTIONS LLP offers opportunities to grow skills in SEO, digital marketing, and web technologies while contributing to measurable business results.
  
**Role Description**
The Search Engine Optimization Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Kottayam. This role is responsible for planning and implementing SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings, website traffic, and lead generation. Day-to-day tasks include performing keyword research, optimizing on-page elements, conducting SEO audits, tracking performance metrics, and preparing reports. The role also involves link building activities, coordinating with content and development teams to implement SEO recommendations, and collaborating on social media marketing initiatives to support overall digital visibility. The SEO Executive is expected to stay current with search engine algorithms, best practices, and industry trends.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Keyword Research and On-Page SEO, including optimizing titles, meta descriptions, headings, and content structure.
* Candidates should possess skills in Link Building, including outreach, acquiring quality backlinks, and managing off-page SEO activities.
* Candidates should possess skills in SEO Audits, including identifying technical, content, and performance issues and proposing actionable recommendations.
* Candidates should possess skills in Social Media Marketing to support SEO efforts through content promotion and brand visibility.
* Candidates should have experience with SEO tools (such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and popular keyword research tools) and a basic understanding of HTML and website structures.
* Candidates should demonstrate analytical thinking, attention to detail, effective communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment.
* A relevant degree or certification in marketing, IT, or digital marketing is beneficial, along with prior experience in SEO or digital marketing roles.

title: Customer Care Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Farmer First is an organization dedicated to recognizing and honoring the essential role of farmers in sustaining human life. Rooted in a vision of empowerment, the organization focuses on upholding farmers’ rights, dignity, and contributions to society. Farmer First promotes a world where humanity, nature, and all living beings coexist in balance. Team members contribute to this mission by supporting initiatives that improve farmers’ livelihoods and strengthen agricultural communities.

**Role Description**
The Customer Care Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Thodupuzha. This role involves responding to customer inquiries, resolving issues promptly, and ensuring a positive experience for farmers and other stakeholders. The Customer Care Executive will handle phone calls, messages, and face-to-face interactions, provide accurate information about services and products, and record customer feedback for continuous improvement. The role also includes coordinating with internal teams to address customer needs, supporting basic sales and service processes, and maintaining clear, courteous communication at all times.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer-focused skills, including Customer Support, Customer Service, and commitment to Customer Satisfaction.
* Excellent Communication abilities, both verbal and written, with active listening and clear, respectful interaction.
* Basic Sales skills, with the ability to explain offerings, guide customers through options, and support upselling or cross-selling when appropriate.
* Ability to build trust with diverse customers, including farmers and partners, demonstrating empathy and patience.
* Good problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in handling customer information.
* Comfort working on-site in Thodupuzha, with readiness to collaborate in a team environment and adapt to changing needs.
* Prior experience in customer-facing roles, preferably in agriculture, social impact, or service-oriented organizations, is an advantage.
* Basic computer literacy and familiarity with phone, email, and messaging tools; proficiency in local languages and English is beneficial.

title: MEP DESIGN ENGINEER
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented MEP Design Engineer to handle the design, planning, and coordination of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems for residential and commercial projects. The candidate should have good technical knowledge, design skills, and experience in coordinating with architects, structural engineers, and project execution teams.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. MEP Design & Planning**

* Prepare MEP layouts, drawings, and technical designs for residential and commercial projects.
* Design electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and fire-fighting systems as per project requirements.
* Develop detailed drawings using AutoCAD, Revit MEP, or other relevant software.
* Ensure proper integration of MEP systems with architectural and structural drawings.

**2. Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other consultants.
* Review architectural and structural drawings to identify design conflicts.
* Ensure proper space planning for electrical, plumbing, and mechanical installations.
* Attend design coordination meetings and provide technical inputs.

**3. Standards & Compliance**

* Ensure MEP designs comply with applicable building codes, safety standards, and regulations.
* Prepare technical specifications, BOQs, and material requirements.
* Review drawings and ensure design accuracy and quality.

**4. Project Support**

* Coordinate with site engineers and execution teams during project implementation.
* Provide technical clarification and resolve design-related issues.
* Conduct site visits to verify MEP installation as per approved drawings.
* Suggest suitable solutions for design changes and site requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
* 4- 6 years of relevant experience in MEP design.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit MEP.
* Good knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire-fighting systems.
* Understanding of building codes and MEP standards.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
**Company Description**
Cks medvana is a healthcare provider dedicated to delivering patient-centered medical services to the local community in and around Thalappally. The organization focuses on high-quality, evidence-based care with an emphasis on rehabilitation, recovery, and overall well-being. Interdisciplinary collaboration is encouraged to ensure that each patient receives comprehensive, individualized treatment. Team members are supported with a professional environment that values integrity, respect, and continuous learning. The physiotherapy department plays a key role in helping patients restore function, reduce pain, and improve quality of life.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Physiotherapist role based in Thalappally. The Physiotherapist will assess patients’ physical conditions, including strength, mobility, balance, and pain levels, and develop individualized treatment plans aligned with clinical best practices. Daily responsibilities include administering therapeutic exercises, manual therapy, electrotherapy and other modalities, instructing patients in home exercise programs, and monitoring progress over time. The role involves maintaining accurate clinical documentation, collaborating with physicians and other healthcare professionals, and educating patients and caregivers on injury prevention, post-operative care, and lifestyle modifications. The Physiotherapist will also contribute to quality improvement initiatives and uphold all safety, ethical, and regulatory standards within the practice.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Relevant academic background such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Physiotherapy from an accredited institution; valid professional registration or license as required by local regulations.
* Clinical skills in patient assessment, treatment planning, manual therapy, therapeutic exercise prescription, and use of rehabilitation modalities for musculoskeletal, neurological, and post-surgical conditions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with patients, families, and multidisciplinary team members, with the ability to explain treatment plans and progress clearly and respectfully.
* Solid organizational and documentation abilities, including maintaining accurate patient records, managing caseloads effectively, and adhering to clinical protocols and infection control standards.
* Demonstrated commitment to ethical practice, patient confidentiality, and professional conduct, along with openness to continuous learning, evidence-based practice, and participation in training or workshops.
* Prior experience in a hospital, clinic, or rehabilitation center is preferred; familiarity with community-based or outpatient physiotherapy services in similar settings is an advantage.

description:
**Company Description**
IAN Institute of Rehabilitation & Research is a comprehensive multi-specialty hospital dedicated to rehabilitation services for children with diverse disabilities. With over a decade of experience, the institute provides patient-centered care in physical, mental, and neurological rehabilitation. A multidisciplinary team of doctors, therapists, and rehabilitation experts focuses on conditions such as Cerebral Palsy, Autism, Down syndrome, genetic disorders, and other physical and neurological issues. Software Development / Enterprise Applications

Finance, Procurement, Real Estate / Property Management

We are looking for an experienced Technical Specialist with over 10 years of experience in the software industry and strong domain knowledge in Finance and Procurement. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of business processes, functional workflows, and technical implementations across financial management and procurement systems.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding business requirements, translating them into technical and functional specifications, guiding development teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of enterprise software solutions.

**1. Domain & Functional Expertise**

* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Vendor Management processes.

* Review technical solutions to ensure they align with business requirements and industry standards.

**3. Project Implementation & Client Engagement**

* Support UAT, system validation, deployment, and post-implementation activities.
* Coordinate with development teams to ensure timely and quality delivery.

* Knowledge of real estate financial operations, property accounting, and project cost management.
* Understanding of lease management, rental billing, maintenance expenses, vendor contracts, and facility management.

* Experience in functional requirement documentation, workflow design, and system integration.
* Good understanding of APIs, databases, software architecture, and enterprise application development.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional development teams.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in Real Estate, Property Management, Facility Management, or Construction Management software.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise systems.
* Exposure to financial automation, procurement automation, and workflow management platforms.
* Experience in client-facing technical consulting or solution architecture roles.

Key Expectations

* The candidate should be capable of acting as a domain and technical bridge between business stakeholders and software development teams, ensuring that complex Finance and Procurement business requirements are translated into scalable, practical, and user-friendly software solutions.

title: Food Service Staff
description:
**Company Description**
Malabar Restaurant is a small Indian restaurant located in the West End of Dundee near the university area, offering a convenient and welcoming setting for guests and staff. The restaurant is known for its informal atmosphere, helpful team members, and dedicated chefs who focus on delivering a positive dining experience. Malabar specializes in South Indian cuisine, reflecting its name and cultural roots. Team members work together to provide attentive service and ensure customers enjoy the unique taste and quality of the food. The environment supports learning about authentic South Indian dishes and customer-focused hospitality.
  
**Role Description**
The Food Service Staff role at Malabar Restaurant is a full-time, on-site position based in Kunnathunad. The role involves greeting guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, and ensuring tables and service areas are clean and well-organized throughout the shift. Food Service Staff support the kitchen team by coordinating orders, answering customer questions about menu items, and helping maintain smooth service during busy periods. The position also includes handling payments, assisting with simple sales-related tasks such as promoting specials, and responding promptly to guest requests or concerns. Team members are expected to follow hygiene and safety standards, contribute to a friendly atmosphere, and support coworkers to deliver consistent, high-quality service.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Customer Service and Communication skills to interact effectively with guests and team members.
* Candidates should possess Sales and basic Finance skills to manage billing, payments, and promote menu items or specials.
* Candidates should possess Analytical Skills to handle orders accurately, prioritize tasks, and solve service-related issues efficiently.
* Previous experience in food service, hospitality, or retail is beneficial.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, work flexible shifts, and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
* Basic knowledge or interest in Indian and South Indian cuisine is an advantage.
* Reliability, teamwork, and a customer-focused mindset are essential.

title: Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Experimental and Computational Applied Mechanics
description:
**About the Position**

The Department of Mechanical Engineering at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus, invites applications for one position of Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Experimental and Computational Applied Mechanics. The fellow will work on stress analysis, composite structures and structural health monitoring, combining full-field optical experiments with finite element modelling. The role also includes interdisciplinary applications of solid mechanics in biomedical, energy, manufacturing and smart-material areas.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

The fellow will carry out experimental stress analysis and mechanical testing using full-field optical methods such as photoelasticity and digital image correlation (DIC), strain gauges and standard ASTM/ISO tests, including the design of specimens and fixtures. The fellow will develop and validate finite element models of components and structures and correlate numerical predictions with experimental results.

The work also involves fabricating and characterising composite and advanced materials and investigating damage, fracture, fatigue and failure mechanisms. The fellow will develop structural health monitoring and non-destructive evaluation methods supported by inverse, image-processing and data-driven techniques, and contribute to interdisciplinary applications of solid mechanics in biomedical, energy, manufacturing and smart-material areas.

The fellow is expected to publish in high-impact journals, prepare funding proposals and patents, mentor students, and deliver project reports and milestones on time.

**Eligibility**

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil (Structural), Applied Mechanics, Engineering Mechanics, Materials Engineering or a closely related discipline, with doctoral research in solid mechanics, experimental mechanics, computational mechanics, composite materials, structural health monitoring or mechanical design. Applicants should also hold an M.E./M.Tech. in Machine Design, Engineering Design, Applied/Engineering Mechanics, Structural Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Composite/Materials Engineering or an allied specialisation. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis may also apply.

A strong record of publications in SCI/Scopus-indexed journals and hands-on experience in both experimental and numerical work are desirable.

**Technical Skills**

The candidate should have strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, including elasticity, strength of materials, mechanics of composites, and fracture and fatigue. Experience in experimental stress analysis using photoelasticity, DIC or strain gauges, and in mechanical testing as per ASTM/ISO standards, is expected. The candidate should be proficient in finite element analysis using ANSYS, ABAQUS or COMSOL and in CAD tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA or Creo. Programming skills in Python or MATLAB for data analysis and image processing, along with good research writing and publication skills, are required.

title: Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Lead AI / Agentic Platform Architect**
with strong hands-on expertise in designing, architecting, and engineering LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions.

The candidate should also be comfortable working in the
**US EST time zone**
to ensure close collaboration with the client team. The ideal candidate should have practical experience building and orchestrating AI agents, integrating LLMs, designing agent runtimes, implementing tool integrations, and establishing scalable, secure, and governed AI platforms. This role requires someone who can evaluate existing agentic AI architectures, understand platform dependencies, define technical standards, establish evaluation frameworks, and identify gaps in safety, security, and AI governance. The candidate should be equally comfortable with architecture-level decisions and hands-on technical implementation.

**Work Schedule:**
Must be flexible and willing to work in the US Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.

**Responsibilities include:**

**Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Design and architect scalable, enterprise-grade agentic AI platforms and solutions.
* Define agent orchestration patterns, runtime architecture, workflows, and multi-agent communication mechanisms.
* Architect prompt engineering frameworks, tool calling, connectors, and model integration strategies.
* Design memory management, state persistence, and context management mechanisms.
* Evaluate and implement RAG architectures and vector database integrations wherever applicable.

**LLM & AI Integration**

* Design and integrate LLM-based applications using leading commercial and open-source models.
* Establish model integration patterns, routing, fallback mechanisms, and model selection strategies.
* Define reusable components and frameworks for agent development and deployment.
* Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and token consumption.

**AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Observability**

* Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance.
* Establish mechanisms for testing prompts, tools, workflows, and end-to-end agent behaviour.
* Implement telemetry, monitoring, tracing, and observability for agentic systems.
* Define mechanisms to identify hallucinations, failures, and performance bottlenecks.

**AI Safety, Security & Governance**

* Identify and address security and governance gaps in agentic AI architectures.
* Establish guardrails for responsible AI implementation, including access controls and data protection.
* Define policies for tool permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent execution boundaries.
* Ensure appropriate compliance, auditability, and governance standards are incorporated into the architecture.

**Technical Leadership & Architecture Assessment**

* Assess existing AI and agentic platform architectures and map technical dependencies.
* Identify architecture gaps, integration challenges, scalability risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend target-state architecture and implementation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.

Primary Skills :

* 5+ years of experience in software architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic AI systems.
* Strong understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, multi-agent systems, and workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, function calling, and tool orchestration.
* Experience designing memory, state management, context handling, and RAG-based architectures.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to assess complex architectures, identify dependencies, and recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Secondary Skills :

* Experience with frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Exposure to cloud-based AI ecosystems such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Azure AI Search.
* Familiarity with agent evaluation tools, tracing, and monitoring frameworks.
* Experience designing enterprise AI platforms with security, scalability, and cost optimization considerations.

**Company Description**

* Willingness to travel locally within Kerala for site work and to work flexible hours based on project and service needs.

What you will do

• Connect with potential investors by phone, WhatsApp and in person

• Explain the investment opportunities clearly and honestly

• Handle investor enquiries and follow up until each one is closed

• Build and maintain strong, long-term investor relationships

• Achieve your assigned monthly targets

• Keep every investor interaction recorded on the company system

• Fluent English, spoken and written (must)

title: Orthodontist
description:
**Company Description**
Resident Dental Clinic, located in Vazhakkala, Ernakulam, is a community-focused practice offering a range of general and specialized dental services. The clinic is committed to providing safe, evidence-based care in a welcoming and professional environment. A focus on patient comfort, clear communication, and preventive care guides everyday operations. The team values collaboration, continuous learning, and ethical practice to deliver consistent, high-quality oral health outcomes.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Orthodontist role based at Resident Dental Clinic in Ernakulam. The Orthodontist will diagnose and plan treatments for malocclusion and other orthodontic concerns, including the use of braces, aligners, and related appliances. Daily responsibilities include conducting clinical evaluations, interpreting diagnostic records, creating individualized treatment plans, and performing regular follow-up adjustments. The role involves educating patients and families on treatment progress, oral hygiene, and appliance care, while collaborating with general dentists and other dental professionals to ensure coordinated care. The Orthodontist is expected to maintain accurate clinical documentation, adhere to regulatory and safety standards, and contribute to a patient-centered, respectful clinic environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Medicine and Dentistry, with the ability to integrate general health considerations into dental and orthodontic care.
* Specialized expertise in Orthodontics, including diagnosis, treatment planning, and management of malocclusion and dentofacial irregularities.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Treatment procedures related to orthodontic interventions, including appliance placement, adjustments, and follow-up care.
* Comprehensive knowledge of Dental Care principles, preventive dentistry, and patient education to support long-term oral health.
* Bachelor’s degree in Dentistry (BDS) and recognized postgraduate qualification in Orthodontics (MDS or equivalent); valid dental council registration.
* Strong clinical judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to evidence-based practice and infection control standards.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain complex procedures clearly and build trust with patients of diverse backgrounds.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary dental team and manage a consistent full-time clinical schedule.

title: Head of E-commerce Marketplaces
description:
**Job Description – Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**

**Company:**
Helett Enterprises LLP

**Position:**
Head – E-commerce Marketplaces

**Department:**
Marketplace

**Experience:**
Minimum 6–10 years in E-commerce / Online Retail

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Industry:**
Electronics / E-commerce / Online Retail

**Language:**
English (Mandatory)

**Salary:**
Attractive salary package based on experience, expertise, and current industry standards. Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the interview.

**1. About the Role**

Helett Enterprises LLP is looking for a highly experienced, strategic, and result-oriented
**Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**
to lead and manage the company's complete online marketplace business.

The candidate will be responsible for overall marketplace strategy, business development, revenue generation, profitability, advertising performance, account management, and team leadership.

This is a senior leadership position requiring strong hands-on expertise in Amazon Marketplace, along with experience managing multiple e-commerce platforms.

The selected candidate will be expected to take complete ownership of marketplace operations, establish business strategies, achieve ambitious revenue targets, improve profit margins, and build a high-performing marketplace team.

**Amazon Marketplace experience is mandatory.**

**2. Key Roles and Core Responsibilities**

**A. Overall Marketplace Business Leadership**

* Take complete ownership of the company's marketplace business, including sales, revenue, profitability, and operational performance.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term marketplace business strategies.
* Prepare annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly business plans with measurable targets.
* Establish revenue, sales growth, profitability, and market-share objectives.
* Identify business opportunities, new product categories, and potential marketplace expansion.
* Analyse business performance and take corrective action whenever targets are not achieved.
* Present regular business performance reports and strategic recommendations to management.
* Ensure marketplace operations align with the company's overall business objectives.

**B. Amazon Marketplace – Strategic and Operational Management**

* Independently manage and scale Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central operations.
* Take responsibility for complete Amazon account management and business performance.
* Manage product listings, catalogue creation, variation listings, A+ Content, Brand Store, and product information.
* Develop strategies to improve product ranking, organic visibility, conversion rates, and Buy Box performance.
* Manage Amazon PPC campaigns, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertisements.
* Plan and optimise advertising budgets to achieve profitable ROAS and ACOS targets.
* Monitor account health, policy violations, customer feedback, returns, cancellations, and operational issues.
* Develop strategies to improve product reviews, ratings, customer experience, and listing quality.
* Manage Amazon FBA, FBM, inventory replenishment, and fulfilment-related coordination.
* Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams to avoid stockouts and excess inventory.
* Handle Amazon account escalations, policy compliance, and performance-related issues.
* Analyse competitor pricing, market trends, keywords, and product performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales velocity and marketplace profitability.

**C. Other E-commerce Platform Management**

* Lead and grow the company's business across Flipkart, Shopify, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* Develop individual growth strategies for each marketplace.
* Manage platform-specific product listings, catalogues, pricing, promotions, and advertising.
* Monitor sales performance, customer experience, returns, and operational efficiency across platforms.
* Explore new online sales channels and marketplace opportunities.
* Ensure consistent product information, brand positioning, and pricing strategies across platforms.
* Improve website traffic, conversion rates, customer retention, and direct online sales through Shopify.

**D. Sales, Revenue and Profitability Management**

* Take direct responsibility for achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual marketplace revenue targets.
* Develop strategies to increase sales volume, average order value, and product-level profitability.
* Monitor gross revenue, net sales, contribution margins, marketplace fees, logistics costs, and advertising expenses.
* Analyse product-wise and platform-wise profitability.
* Identify low-performing products and implement corrective strategies.
* Develop pricing and discount strategies without compromising profit margins.
* Prepare revenue forecasts and business projections.
* Identify opportunities to increase organic sales and reduce dependency on paid advertising.
* Ensure sustainable business growth rather than focusing only on revenue numbers.

**E. Advertising, Marketing and Brand Growth**

* Lead marketplace advertising and performance marketing strategies.
* Plan and manage PPC campaigns, sponsored advertisements, promotional campaigns, and seasonal sales.
* Set advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
* Improve ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-term optimisation.
* Work closely with the design and content teams to improve product images, videos, A+ Content, and listing quality.
* Develop strategies for product launches and new product marketing.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and ensure marketing expenditure generates measurable business results.

**F. Product Launch and Business Expansion**

* Identify new product opportunities based on market demand, competitor analysis, and sales trends.
* Coordinate with product development, sourcing, procurement, and QC teams for new product launches.
* Prepare product launch plans, pricing strategies, advertising plans, and sales forecasts.
* Monitor new product performance during the initial launch period.
* Develop strategies for product portfolio expansion.
* Coordinate with management on international marketplace expansion and new business opportunities.

**G. Inventory, Supply Chain and Operations Coordination**

* Work closely with Inventory, Warehouse, QC, Finance, and Supply Chain departments.
* Prepare marketplace inventory forecasts based on sales trends and future demand.
* Ensure timely replenishment of Amazon fulfilment centres and other marketplace warehouses.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving products, excess inventory, and stockout risks.
* Coordinate shipment planning with inventory and QC teams.
* Ensure products are properly inspected and ready before marketplace shipment.
* Monitor fulfilment performance, delivery issues, cancellations, and return rates.
* Develop operational processes to improve marketplace efficiency.

**H. Team Leadership and Performance Management**

* Lead, manage, and develop the complete marketplace team.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear departmental reporting structures.
* Set individual and team KPIs, targets, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure accountability.
* Identify training requirements and improve the team's technical and operational capabilities.
* Recruit and develop skilled marketplace professionals.
* Ensure coordination between Marketplace, Finance, Design, Inventory, QC, Customer Service, and Operations.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on business results and continuous improvement.

**I. Reporting, Analysis and Management Review**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly marketplace performance reports.
* Monitor revenue, sales growth, profit margins, advertising expenditure, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and conversion rates.
* Prepare platform-wise, product-wise, and category-wise performance analysis.
* Identify gaps between targets and actual achievements.
* Present business performance, challenges, opportunities, and action plans to management.
* Develop data-driven recommendations for improving business performance.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all marketplace reporting.

**3. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce and online marketplace management.
* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central is mandatory.
* Experience in Amazon Vendor Central is highly preferred.
* Proven track record of independently managing and scaling marketplace businesses.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon PPC, advertising optimisation, SEO, catalogue management, and account health.
* Experience managing Flipkart, Shopify, and other e-commerce platforms.
* Strong understanding of revenue management, business profitability, pricing, and advertising ROI.
* Experience leading and managing marketplace teams.
* Excellent analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of Excel, business analytics, reporting, and marketplace performance tools.
* Ability to work with management and independently take ownership of business targets.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Head – E-commerce Marketplaces will be evaluated based on measurable business results, including:

1. **Revenue Achievement:**
   Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
2. **Profitability:**
   Improvement in net contribution and product-level profit margins.
3. **Marketplace Growth:**
   Growth across Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, and other platforms.
4. **Advertising Efficiency:**
   Improvement in ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and advertising ROI.
5. **Organic Sales Growth:**
   Improvement in organic revenue and product rankings.
6. **Inventory Management:**
   Reduction in stockouts, excess stock, and inventory ageing.
7. **Product Launch Performance:**
   Successful launch and growth of new products.
8. **Account Health:**
   Maintaining healthy marketplace accounts and policy compliance.
9. **Team Performance:**
   Achievement of departmental and individual employee KPIs.
10. **Business Reporting:**
    Accurate reporting, forecasting, and timely management reviews.

title: Draughtsman
description:
**Company Description**
B4builders is a growing construction and design-focused organization committed to delivering high-quality residential and commercial projects. The company emphasizes practical, efficient solutions tailored to client needs, with attention to structural integrity, usability, and aesthetics. Team members collaborate closely across design, engineering, and site execution to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. B4builders values clear communication, professional integrity, and continuous improvement in both technical skills and project delivery. The organization offers opportunities for growth for individuals who are detail-oriented and interested in advancing within the construction and design sector.

**Role Description**
The Draughtsman will prepare detailed architectural and structural drawings, plans, and layouts based on project specifications and design inputs from engineers and architects. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating and updating 2D/3D drawings, coordinating revisions, ensuring drawings comply with relevant standards, and maintaining organized documentation of design files. The role involves collaborating with project teams to clarify design requirements, supporting quantity estimation with accurate drawings, and occasionally visiting sites to understand practical constraints and verify measurements. This is a full-time hybrid role, based in Palghat, with some flexibility for work from home as project needs and team coordination allow.

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in technical drawing and drafting using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, or similar tools).
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings, and translate concepts into clear, usable plans.
* Knowledge of building construction methods, materials, and local building codes or standards.
* Attention to detail, accuracy in measurements, and strong organizational skills for managing multiple drawing sets.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with architects, engineers, and site teams.
* Diploma or certification in Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related field; relevant experience in construction or design offices is an advantage.
* Comfort with hybrid work arrangements, including the ability to work on-site in Palghat and remotely when required.

title: Senior Consultant – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
description:
**Company Description**
CliniLaunch Research Institute (CLRI) is an advanced clinical research and professional training center focused on bridging the gap between aspiring professionals and the clinical research industry. The institute aims to support graduates from Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medicine, and Paramedical fields in building careers in clinical research through industry-aligned programs. CLRI partners with leading organizations to offer practical training and pathways to meaningful employment. With a strong track record of graduates successfully completing its programs, CLRI has become a prominent contributor of skilled professionals to the clinical research sector.

**Role Description**
The Senior Consultant – Obstetrics & Gynaecology will provide expert clinical guidance for training programs, research initiatives, and academic activities in the field of maternal and reproductive health. This full-time, on-site role, based in Kerala, India, involves supervising clinical content development, delivering lectures and workshops, and mentoring trainees and junior faculty. The consultant will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design evidence-based curricula, support ongoing clinical research projects, and ensure adherence to ethical and regulatory standards. Additional responsibilities include reviewing case studies and protocols, contributing to publications, and representing the institute in professional forums and industry interactions.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced clinical expertise in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, including diagnosis, management, and evidence-based practices.
* Experience in clinical research, protocol development, and interpretation of scientific data in women’s health.
* Strong teaching, mentoring, and academic leadership skills for training healthcare and clinical research professionals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration abilities for working with multidisciplinary teams and trainees.
* Commitment to ethical clinical practice, regulatory compliance, and patient-centered care in all activities.
* Recognized medical qualification (e.g., MBBS, MS / DNBequivalent specialization in Obstetrics & Gynaecology) from an accredited institution.
* Prior experience in a senior clinical, academic, or consultant role, preferably within a teaching or research environment.
* Familiarity with national and international clinical guidelines, good clinical practice (GCP), and relevant regulatory frameworks.

title: School Lunch Services Supervisor - School Food Services Branch (Leeward)
description:
**Description**
**Salary Range:**
All new external applicants will be placed on the initial step of the salary range. However, placement above the initial step of the salary range will be based on special characteristics and critical needs of the position, an applicant's exceptional qualifications, the availability of funds, and other relevant factors. Such appointments require prior approval. Hawaii State Department of Education employees will be placed on the salary range in accordance with Department regulations.
  
  
School Lunch Services Supervisor, SR-24: $6,221.00 - $7,568.00 per month
  
  
**Examples of Duties**

* Visits public schools in an assigned district and supervises cafeteria managers for effective and efficient cafeteria operations.
* Reviews and instructs on school lunch menus for the maintenance of well-balanced lunches.
* Reviews and directs improvements in methods of food preparation and serving, storage, purchasing and other operations.
* Instructs on cleaning methods, hygiene and safe kitchen practices.
* Checks cafeteria records and reports and explains pertinent policies and procedures.
* Inspects public and private schools and institutions for the proper use and storage of federal food commodities.
* Reports on the maintenance of lunch standards by public schools.
* Recommends the transfer and placement of school lunch personnel, and encourages cafeteria managers to obtain further training.
* Reviews cafeteria equipment and supply needs of schools in an assigned district.
* Recommends and effectuates the transfer of cafeteria equipment between schools.
* Participates in the in-service training of cafeteria managers.
* Reviews and acts on reports prepared by cafeteria managers.
* Prepares summary reports of cafeteria operations in an assigned district, and reports on work activities.
* Prepares printed guides and other instructional and informational materials relative to the school lunch program.
* Participates in the review of plans for remodeling and building school cafeterias; and,
* Discusses the school lunch program with school officials, interested groups and individuals.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education Requirement**
: Graduation from an accredited college or university with specialization in food service management or nutrition.
  
  
**Substitution of Experience for Education**
: Excess experience as described in the experience requirement below may be substituted for the education requirement on a year-for-year basis.
  
  
**E**
**xperience Requirement**
: Four years of one or a combination of the following: 1) food service management experience. Which involved training and directing personnel, managing the purchase of food and supplies, enforcing sanitary regulations, preparing records and reports, and planning menus; or 2) experience as a teacher or consultant in the field of nutrition or food service management.
  
  
**Substitution of Education for Experience**
: Possession of a Master’s degree in a field specified under the education requirement may be substituted for one year of the experience required.
  
  
**Quality of Ex**
**perience**
: Possession of the required amount of experience will not in itself be accepted as proof of qualification for a position. The applicant’s overall experience must have been of such scope and responsibility as to conclusively demonstrate that applicant has the ability to perform the duties of the position for which applicant is being considered.
  
  
**Driver's License Requirement**
: Applicants must possess a current, valid driver's license.
  
  
**Food Safety Certification Requirement**
: Applicants must possess a valid food handler's training level certification from the Hawaii Department of Health, American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited organizations, or equivalent organization as determined by the Department of Education.
  
  
**Supplemental Information**
**Salary:**
The advertised salary is based on full-time employment and includes shortage and school year differentials, if applicable.
  
  
**Requirements:**
Applicants must meet all the requirements for the position they are seeking as of the date of the application, unless otherwise specified. Unless specifically indicated, the required education and experience may not be gained concurrently. Calculation of experience is based on full-time, 40-hour workweeks. Part-time experience is pro-rated. Example: Twelve months of experience at 20 hours/week is equivalent to six months of experience, not one year. Also, hours worked in excess of 40 hours/week will not be credited. Example: Twelve months of experience at 60 hours/week is equivalent to one year of experience, not one and a half years.
  
  
**********Temporary Assignment:**********
Claims of Temporary Assignment (TA) experience to meet the minimum qualification requirements must be verified and attached to the application using one of the options below:
  
  

* A copy of the applicant’s TA History Report or equivalent system-generated report;
* A signed letter from the applicant’s supervisor that includes the applicant’s name, his/her TA job title, the TA start and end dates (from mm/yy to mm/yy), his/her specific TA duties performed, and either the TA hours worked per week or total TA hours worked; or,
* Copies of the applicant’s signed SF-10 Forms.

******Documents:******
Attach all relevant supporting documents to your application. Documents that were attached to applications submitted before November 16, 2023 do not automatically attach or transfer to applications submitted on and after December 16, 2023. All submitted documents become the property of the Hawaii State Department of Education.
  
  
**Information about Temporary Positions:**
Temporary positions may be extended year to year, dependent upon funding and departmental needs. Making yourself available for temporary positions increases your employment possibilities and may lead to permanent opportunities. A person hired for a temporary position may also become a temporary employee upon satisfactory completion of the initial probation period of at least six months. Once a temporary employee, you would be eligible to apply for promotion and transfer opportunities to permanent as well as other temporary positions. You may also enjoy other rights and benefits as afforded to an employee in a permanent position, with the exception of return rights and placement rights associated with a reduction-in-force.

**Payday**

**12-month civil service and SSP employees enjoy a range of competitive benefits:**

* Premium Conversion Plan: Participating employees may increase their take-home pay by having the State deduct the cost of health care premiums before payroll taxes are withheld.
* Flexible Spending Accounts: Eligible employees can reduce their federal and state income taxes and social security taxes through a tax-savings benefit program called Island Flex. This program allows employees to set aside money from their paychecks to pay for out-of-pocket health care expenses and eligible dependent care expenses on a BEFORE-TAX basis.
* Retirement Plan: The State contributes to a retirement plan for eligible employees. Generally, employees with at least 10 years of credited service and who have reached 62 years of age or have 30 years of credited service and are 55 years old may retire and receive benefits.
* Tax Shelter Annuity (TSA): If eligible, Department employees are able to participate in a tax shelter annuity program. The TSA plan allows eligible employees to contribute pre-tax dollars to an employee-selected investment service provider authorized to provide TSA products.
* Deferred Compensation: The State offers employees a tax deferred (sheltered) retirement investment program. This program is an opportunity to build a retirement nest egg through voluntary payroll deductions. Several investment options are available.
* Temporary Disability Insurance: Qualified employees may be eligible to receive benefits for a disability caused by a non-work related injury or illness under this program.
* Social Security: As an employer, the State also contributes to an employee's social security account.
* Workers' Compensation: If an employee is injured while on the job, benefits covering medical expenses and partial wage support may be available through workers' compensation.
* Union & Collective Bargaining: Employees have the right to join the union for collective bargaining with the State and employee representation. Some employee unions provide discounts, insurance and other opportunities. Employees may also decide not to join a union, however, employees are required to pay union service fees unless the employee's job is excluded from collective bargaining.

The above is intended as a general summary of the benefits offered and is subject to change. This does not constitute a contract or binding agreement. Benefits vary by type of employment appointment and collective bargaining agreements.

title: App Experience Analyst
description:
Life Pharmacy is the UAE’s largest retail pharmacy chain, with 600+ stores. It runs the region’s No. 1 pharmacy app, which serves thousands of customers every day with medicines, wellness, beauty and fast home delivery. Life Pharmacy is part of Life Group, which also includes Life Medical Centre and Life GP Clinics.

**The role**

We’re looking for someone whose full-time job is to use the Life Pharmacy app as our most demanding customer would. You’ll find what’s broken, confusing or costing us sales, and turn it into clear recommendations that our product and tech teams act on. You’ll report directly to the Head of eCommerce in Dubai.

**What you’ll do**

* Test the core app journeys daily on iOS, Android and web: search, product pages, cart, checkout, prescription upload, Click & Collect and order tracking
* Check our top-searched products every day for correct results, pricing, offers and stock
* Benchmark Life Pharmacy against leading UAE apps such as Noon, Amazon, Talabat and InstaShop
* Track app store reviews and spot recurring customer pain points
* Test every new app release and campaign before and after launch
* Send a weekly report of the top 10 issues and ideas, ranked by customer and sales impact

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–4 years in e-commerce app QA, UX research, product operations or catalog quality
* A sharp eye for detail: you notice a wrong price or a broken filter before anyone else
* Clear, structured written English, with screenshots, impact and a suggested fix for every finding
* A heavy user of shopping and delivery apps who naturally compares experiences
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets, Jira or similar trackers, and screen recording tools

**Nice to have**

* B.Pharm or a pharmacy background
* Experience with UAE or GCC shopping apps
* A basic understanding of app analytics: funnels, conversion and search data

In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. While the role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

A Relationship Manager is a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs. The core philosophy to hold is being Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

* **Business Development:**
  Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers
* **Champion 360-degree banking:**
  Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.
* **Enhance the portfolio quality:**
  Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to the Bank, Fair to the Customer

  As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch
* **Behold the values:**
  Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the Bank

* **Communication:**
  Good oral and written communication skills

* **Improvise:**
  Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.
* **Market Sensing:**
  Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

Retail Banking Group at ICICI Bank serves customer segments consisting of individuals, self-employed professionals, SMEs, proprietors, government, and retail institutions. With widespread presence across the country, our relationship team is dedicated to serving customer needs with a 360-degree approach. ICICI Bank has a unique bouquet of digital solutions covering the diverse banking needs of customers. To facilitate a seamless customer banking experience, we have adopted the ICICI Stack approach. It covers a complete range of banking services from bank accounts, payments, banking transactions, and credit cards to personal, mortgage, vehicle loans, and business & institutional solutions.

title: Technical Services & Support Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and solution-oriented Technical Services & Support Analyst to join goFLUENT’s Technical Services & Support team.
  
  
As part of the team, you will investigate technical and functional issues reported internally, identify root causes and patterns, assess impact, and coordinate with teams such as Tech, Analytics, Product, Content, and Operations to drive issues through to resolution.
  
  
You’ll be expected to go beyond simply handling tickets: test and reproduce issues, investigate data and system behavior, challenge assumptions, communicate findings clearly, and help us continuously improve products, processes, monitoring, and documentation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a Technical Services & Support Analyst, you will act as a key point of contact for incoming internal support requests. You will own investigations end-to-end, from initial analysis and reproduction through escalation, follow-up, and resolution communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical Investigation & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate technical and functional support requests across goFLUENT products and services.
* Test and reproduce reported issues to validate behavior, understand the conditions in which they occur, and gather the information needed for further investigation.
* Use tools and techniques such as SQL, APIs, browser Developer Tools, HAR files, logs, and application data to investigate issues and validate findings.
* Analyze issues beyond individual cases to identify patterns, determine potential scope and impact, and distinguish isolated cases from broader incidents.
* Identify and apply available workarounds when appropriate, while ensuring permanent issues are properly escalated and followed through.

title: Operations Team Lead
description:
Job Description: Operations Team Lead

**Company:**
Lumina Consulting

**Location:**
Kerala, India

**Job Type:**
Full-time | Hybrid

Company Description

Lumina Consulting supports a UK-based client specialising in the wholesale and distribution of branded products sourced from across the world, with a strong focus on beauty, cosmetics, haircare, personal care, hygiene, and perfumery.

Established in 2017, the client initially operated as a retailer and has since expanded into the B2B wholesale and distribution sector. The business manages an extensive product portfolio, with more than 100,000 SKUs in its inventory, and distributes selected European brands within the UK market.

The company is committed to operational excellence, product authenticity, customer satisfaction, and building efficient, scalable business processes across its retail and wholesale operations.

Role Description

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on, and results-driven
**Operations Team Lead**
to oversee daily business operations and lead a team responsible for e-commerce operations, wholesale order processing, inventory management, and customer service.

This full-time hybrid role is based in Kerala, India, combining on-site responsibilities with some work-from-home flexibility.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining accurate inventory records, managing online product listings, coordinating order fulfilment, and ensuring that customer orders are processed and dispatched on time.

The role requires a strong understanding of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon, alongside experience in wholesale operations, inventory control, and people management. The ideal candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of operational challenges, identifying process improvements, and ensuring that the team consistently meets its performance targets.

Key Responsibilities1. E-commerce Operations

* Oversee day-to-day operations across e-commerce marketplaces and online sales channels.
* Manage Amazon inventory, product listings, stock availability, pricing updates, and order fulfilment processes.
* Coordinate product listing creation, content updates, SKU mapping, EAN/barcode verification, and product data accuracy.
* Monitor marketplace performance, operational metrics, account health, and order processing standards.
* Ensure stock levels and product information remain accurate across all relevant sales channels.
* Identify and resolve listing errors, stock discrepancies, order issues, and other marketplace-related operational problems.

2. Wholesale Operations and Order Management

* Supervise B2B wholesale order processing, customer account requirements, and order fulfilment.
* Coordinate with sales and customer service teams to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
* Monitor outstanding orders, supplier availability, delivery schedules, and dispatch timelines.
* Support wholesale customer enquiries, order updates, and operational escalations.
* Ensure wholesale orders meet agreed service levels and customer expectations.

3. Inventory and Warehouse Coordination

* Maintain accurate inventory records across ERP, inventory management systems, and e-commerce platforms.
* Monitor stock movements, discrepancies, incoming deliveries, and outgoing shipments.
* Coordinate with warehouse and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure appropriate stock control procedures are followed, including SKU, EAN, barcode, expiry-date, and product-condition checks where applicable.

4. Team Leadership and Performance Management

* Lead, supervise, and coach team members to achieve operational objectives.
* Allocate tasks, establish priorities, monitor productivity, and ensure accountability.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and training.
* Encourage teamwork, effective communication, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Address operational errors, delays, and performance issues promptly and professionally.

5. Customer Service and Service-Level Management

* Ensure customer enquiries and complaints are handled professionally and within agreed response times.
* Monitor order accuracy, dispatch performance, delivery issues, and customer satisfaction.
* Resolve escalated operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders.

6. Reporting and Process Improvement

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including order processing time, inventory accuracy, dispatch performance, listing accuracy, and team productivity.
* Prepare regular operational reports and highlight risks, delays, and areas requiring management attention.
* Analyse operational data to identify inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve consistency and scalability.
* Work closely with sales, technology, logistics, and senior management to support business growth.

Qualifications and Required Skills

* Proven experience in e-commerce operations, preferably with hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, product listings, SKU management, and order processing.
* Experience in wholesale, distribution, retail, or FMCG operations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and manage a team effectively.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in customer service, order escalations, and maintaining high service standards.
* Ability to analyse operational data, monitor KPIs, and prepare performance reports.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including data analysis, filtering, sorting, and reporting.
* Experience with ERP, warehouse management, or inventory management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented approach to work.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and make sound operational decisions.
* A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with Amazon, eBay, Shopify, or other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Familiarity with B2B wholesale platforms and high-volume order processing.
* Experience coordinating with third-party logistics (3PL) providers.
* Knowledge of beauty, cosmetics, personal care, haircare, or perfumery products.
* Experience supporting UK-based businesses or working with international teams.
* Familiarity with inventory systems such as Odoo or similar ERP platforms.

Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate will be a dependable and confident leader who combines strong execution skills with a commercial mindset.

They should demonstrate integrity, ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to teamwork. They must be willing to get involved in day-to-day operational tasks while also developing better processes and helping the business scale.

**The objective of this role is simple: build a disciplined, efficient, and accountable operations team that delivers accurate orders, maintains reliable inventory, supports wholesale growth, and consistently meets customer expectations.**

description:
**Company Description**
PhonePe is shaping the future of digital finance in India, enabling millions of people and businesses to manage their money with confidence. Trusted by over 700M users and 50M+ merchants, PhonePe offers a broad ecosystem of services including UPI payments, loans, insurance, wealth management, and merchant solutions. With products like Share.Market, a stock broking platform, and Indus Appstore, a localized app marketplace, the company continues to expand access to digital financial services. title: Project Administration & Coordination Officer
description:
**Project Administration & Coordination Officer**

**Company:**
ABBA Builders

**Project:**
The 5th Avenue – Climate-Resilient Villas

**Location:**
Kuriachira, Thrissur, Kerala

**Required Joining Date:**
On or before 1 November 2026

**Experience:**
3–5 years of relevant experience preferred

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**1. Position Overview**

ABBA Builders is looking for a mature, qualified, responsible, and well-organised professional to manage the administrative and coordination activities of its climate-resilient villa project,
*The 5th Avenue*
, in Thrissur.

The role involves managing project documentation, coordinating with petty contractors and suppliers, liaising with government departments whenever required, supporting the Sales & Marketing Team, and ensuring the smooth execution of day-to-day project activities.

The ideal candidate should be self-disciplined, trustworthy, proactive, and capable of taking positive decisions within authorised limits while strictly following company policies, procedures, and management instructions.

The position requires a hands-on professional who can independently manage multiple small but important activities without constant supervision.

**About ABBA Builders**

ABBA Builders is part of a global business group with
**39 years of business excellence**
, built on a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Pioneering a new approach to sustainable property development in Kerala, ABBA Builders has developed
**The 5th Avenue – Climate-Resilient Villas**
in Thrissur, with a focus on creating thoughtfully designed homes that respond to Kerala’s changing climatic conditions.

Our vision is to promote sustainable living through climate-conscious design, energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and quality construction. By integrating climate resilience with contemporary living, ABBA Builders aims to contribute to a more sustainable future for residential real estate in Kerala.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Administration & Documentation**

* Manage day-to-day administrative activities related to the villa project.
* Maintain systematic records of agreements, quotations, work orders, invoices, bills, vouchers, correspondence, and other project documents.
* Ensure that documents are properly verified, approved, filed, and submitted within the prescribed timelines.
* Maintain updated records of contractor details, work status, pending activities, and administrative requirements.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all important transactions and communications.

**B. Contractor & Supplier Coordination**

* Coordinate with petty contractors, suppliers, and service providers for ongoing villa project activities.
* Communicate work instructions and follow up on assigned tasks, completion schedules, material requirements, and pending works.
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure timely completion of assigned work and rectification of identified deficiencies.
* Maintain contractor-wise records of work completed, bills submitted, payments pending, and outstanding activities.
* Ensure that all work commitments and instructions are consistent with management approvals.

**C. Government Department & External Coordination**

* Visit and coordinate with relevant government departments, local authorities, utility providers, and other agencies whenever required.
* Handle authorised submissions, document collection, follow-ups, and routine administrative formalities.
* Maintain records of applications, acknowledgements, correspondence, approvals, and pending matters.
* Ensure that official requirements are followed up systematically and delays are brought to management's attention.
* Ensure that no commitments or representations are made on behalf of the company beyond the authority delegated.

**D. Financial Documentation & Expense Control**

* Check contractor bills, supplier invoices, petty cash vouchers, and expense claims for accuracy and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for bill processing, payment documentation, and reconciliation of records.
* Maintain records of project expenses, outstanding bills, advances, and payment status.
* Ensure that all expenses are properly documented and approved in accordance with company policy.
* Report discrepancies, unsupported claims, or irregularities to management promptly.
* Do not make financial commitments or authorise payments without the required approval.

**E. Site Administration, Housekeeping & Snagging Coordination**

* Coordinate with the site team and housekeeping personnel to maintain the villas and project premises in an orderly and presentable condition.
* Follow up with petty contractors on pending snagging, maintenance, and rectification works.
* Maintain a villa-wise snagging and pending-work register and update the status of each item.
* Ensure that issues identified during inspections or customer visits are communicated to the relevant persons and followed up until closure.
* Escalate delays or quality-related concerns to management for appropriate action.

**F. Sales & Marketing Team Support**

* Provide administrative and operational support to the Sales & Marketing Team for villa promotion and sales activities.
* Coordinate with the sales team to arrange site visits for prospective customers and ensure that the villas are ready for inspection.
* Facilitate the availability of property documents, specifications, photographs, and other project-related information required for sales activities.
* Coordinate with the site team and contractors to address customer observations, snagging issues, and rectification requirements promptly.
* Support the coordination of customer visits, property presentation, and other approved marketing activities at the project site.
* Follow up on administrative requirements communicated by the sales team and ensure timely action.
* Maintain effective communication between the management, Sales & Marketing Team, and project site to facilitate a positive customer experience.

**G. Reporting & Management Coordination**

* Submit daily or periodic reports on completed activities, pending tasks, contractor follow-ups, expenses, and issues requiring management attention.
* Maintain a clear action tracker showing responsibilities, target dates, and completion status.
* Communicate important developments, delays, and operational issues to management without waiting for reminders.
* Ensure that instructions received from management are implemented accurately and within the agreed timelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of company documents, financial information, customer details, and business matters.

**3. Candidate Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline; qualifications in Commerce, Business Administration, or Accounting will be an advantage.
* Preferably 3–5 years of experience in construction, real estate, project administration, or a similar operational role.
* Practical knowledge of invoices, bills, vouchers, expense documentation, contractor coordination, and general office administration.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, email, and digital document management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Fluency in Malayalam is essential; basic English communication skills are preferred.
* Willingness to travel locally for site visits, contractor meetings, and government-related work.
* **A valid two-wheeler driving licence and own motorcycle/bike are mandatory.**

**4. Required Personal Attributes**

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

* **Maturity and responsibility:**
  Ability to handle routine operational matters with sound judgement.
* **Integrity and trustworthiness:**
  Responsible handling of company funds, documents, and confidential information.
* **Discipline and compliance:**
  Strict adherence to company policies, procedures, and management instructions.
* **Positive decision-making:**
  Ability to resolve routine issues independently within delegated authority.
* **Proactive follow-up:**
  Ensuring that assigned activities are completed on time without repeated reminders.
* **Organisation and accuracy:**
  Maintaining proper records and managing multiple activities systematically.
* **Coordination skills:**
  Maintaining effective working relationships with contractors, suppliers, government departments, and internal teams.
* **Customer orientation:**
  Supporting the Sales & Marketing Team in maintaining the project and villas in a customer-ready condition.

**5. Performance Expectations**

Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:

1. Timely and accurate maintenance of administrative and financial documentation.
2. Effective follow-up and coordination with contractors, suppliers, and external agencies.
3. Timely closure of pending housekeeping, snagging, and rectification activities.
4. Quality and timeliness of reporting to management.
5. Effective administrative support to the Sales & Marketing Team.
6. Compliance with company policies, approval procedures, and management instructions.
7. Ability to work independently, take appropriate decisions, and demonstrate accountability.

**6. Reporting & Authority**

The Project Administration & Coordination Officer will report to the designated management representative.

The employee is expected to exercise initiative in routine matters while obtaining prior approval for financial commitments, contractual decisions, deviations from company policy, and other matters beyond delegated authority.

**7. Application & Joining Requirements**

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements should submit their updated CV along with:

* Current salary and expected salary.
* Notice period and earliest available joining date.
* Summary of relevant construction or real estate experience.
* Confirmation of possession of a valid two-wheeler driving licence and own motorcycle/bike.

**Required joining date: On or before 1 November 2026.**

ABBA Builders seeks a dependable professional who can take ownership of day-to-day administration and coordination, follow established procedures, and contribute positively to the smooth operation and successful sale of its climate-resilient villas.

The role involves interpreting drawings, assisting in planning and scheduling site activities, coordinating with contractors and other stakeholders, and reporting progress, issues, and risks to project management. The Site Civil Engineer will also help implement best practices in safety, documentation, and site communication to maintain project timelines and quality.

**Qualifications**
